The *Dvinnaṁlokuppannānaṁsamakabhāvapañha* ("The Question on the Speed of Rebirth", Mil 3.7.5) is a dialogue belonging to the *Milindapañha* within the post-canonical Pali literature. The text has been translated into modern languages, including an English translation by John Kelly.

A full curated parallel exists in the Chinese translation of the *Nāgasena-sūtra*, preserved at Taishō 1670b 2.65 under the title "Duration of Taking Rebirth". DharmaNexus also records machine-generated cross-language alignments with Chinese canonical texts, specifically the *Ekottarika Āgama* (T 125) and the *Saṃyukta Āgama* (T 99) [DharmaNexus].
